title: BSA Gold Star 650 Modern Classic (Touring Pack)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the BSA Motorcycles India BSA Gold Star 650 Modern Classic (Touring Pack) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. At its heart lies a 650cc powertrain delivering 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 193 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 15.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
